title: The Jellyfish That Can Live Forever

scenes.text: There's a jellyfish that can live forever.
Its scientific name is a mouthful, so scientists just call it the immortal jellyfish. It's about the size of your fingernail.
When it gets injured, starved or old, it does something no other animal can.
It turns its body back into a polyp, its baby stage, and starts life over from the beginning.
It can repeat this again and again, which makes it biologically immortal.
It can still be eaten. But it will never die of old age.

description:
Turritopsis dohrnii, the immortal jellyfish, can revert its adult body back to its polyp stage and start life again, as many times as it needs.
It's the only known animal that's biologically immortal.
Would you want that ability?
